eyebrow: If any of this sounds familiar
title: You are not alone.
intro: Most anxious patients recognize themselves in one of these three profiles. None is rare. All are welcome.

items.fear: Your palms sweat just thinking about the dentist. The sound, the smell, the chair — everything.
items.needs_to_hear: That the first visit is 80% conversation. No instruments. We talk, you leave with a written plan, and only come back when ready.

items.who: You know you should go — and keep postponing.
items.fear: It's been 3, 5, 8 years. The longer you wait, the bigger the imagined problem becomes. The shame builds.
items.needs_to_hear: That I won't make you feel bad. The first visit is review + plan, not a sermon. Many of my patients arrive exactly where you are.

items.who: Something happened before and you can't forget it.
items.fear: A painful extraction, a botched root canal, a dentist who didn't listen. Your body remembers even when you don't want it to.
items.needs_to_hear: That you can ask me to stop at any moment, and I will. We build the visit around what feels safe for you — including bringing someone you trust.
